description: Multi-agent KPI-drop investigator: competing hypotheses tested against Zetaris views, a deterministic Claim Gate, an evidence graph in Meterless H-MEM, model calls through Meterless Nightshift with per-call receipts, and a decision memo with row-level citations. Financial-QA final system: V7 answers + V9_full calibrated confidence.
track: The Agent That Can Explain Why

sponsor_technology.zetaris: Default data layer: five views (v_orders, v_returns, v_tickets, v_logistics, v_promotions) queried over JDBC (Zetaris Lightning) by the Retriever and re-queried by the Evidence Evaluator and Claim Gate. When Zetaris is not configured the same SQL runs on a local DuckDB snapshot (SAMPLE_MODE, the explicit fallback), which is logged and shown in the memo.

meterless.where: Nightshift 1.2.7 is the primary model provider: S1 meterless/fast pinned to Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B (reasoning off), S2 meterless/deep pinned to Nemotron 3 Ultra; startup pin check and logs/receipts-<run_id>.jsonl from the meterless response block; NVIDIA fallback off by default and flagged in receipts. H-MEM stores hypotheses, retrieval calls, evidence and support/refute edges (trust ledger per run); Markovian drives the Evaluator->Planner rounds (vendored Apache-2.0 reference engines via a node bridge). Live Nightshift receipts pending the cloud key in the Nightshift app.

sponsor_technology.nvidia: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B (S1: agentic retriever, relevance filter, Evidence Evaluator) and Nemotron 3 Ultra (S2: Planner, Cause Analyst, Writer) via Nightshift routing to NVIDIA cloud; nemotron-3-embed-1b embeddings. Earlier live dev-split results with Super VL on the direct NVIDIA endpoint in eval/RESULTS_dev_nvidia.md.
sponsor_technology.unique: The Evidence Evaluator re-queries the data itself and can send the Planner back; a deterministic Claim Gate blocks any claim or model-written number that the data does not support.

sample_mode: fallback when Zetaris is not configured (SAMPLE_MODE=true forces it)
data: Synthetic only (scripts/make_data.py, seeded); no real customer data.
ai_usage: Code written during the build window by AI coding agents (Grok Bot) under the author's direction; see README 'AI and Model Usage'.
final_system: V7 answers + V9_full confidence (app/v9conf.py, V9_CONFIDENCE=on by default); results in docs/TEST500_RESULTS.md, docs/V9_HOLDOUT_RESULTS.md, docs/V9_GENERALIZATION_RESULTS.md
